name: PMO Portfolio Register
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Portfolio:Link/PMO Portfolio:220",
    portfolio_name AS "Portfolio Name:Data:220",
    strategic_plan AS "Strategic Plan:Link/PMO Strategic Plan:220",
    portfolio_manager AS "Portfolio Manager:Link/User:180",
    status AS "Status:Data:140"
FROM `tabPMO Portfolio`
ORDER BY portfolio_name
